newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria tenders to buy 12,000 tonnes of rice.
newsitem.headline: Syria tenders to buy 12,000 tonnes of rice.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs (GEZA) has issued an international tender to by 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment in February next year, a company spokesman said on Saturday.
He told Reuters that January 7 had been set as a final date to receive bids for the rice which should be of new season 1997 and the last harvest prior to shipping month.
The results of the tender would be annunced on January 16, the official said.
